identified_issues: Premature classification of HTTP 504 gateway timeout as a definitive transaction failure
Proposed ledger rollback introduces severe desynchronization risk if the queued instruction executes in the clearing network
Core financial ledger marked transaction as COMMITTED with locks released prior to receiving bilateral settlement confirmation
evidence: Outbound gateway recorded HTTP 504 GATEWAY_TIMEOUT and cached state as CALLBACK_PENDING_TIMEOUT at 2026-10-06T08:15:03.210Z rather than a terminal failure
Clearing Bank SFTP Bilateral Statement (WINDOW_ID=20261006_CYCLE_01) reports REJECTION_RECORDS: NONE and omits TX-8102-EUR from finalized records
Clearing Bank Reconciliation Standard 3 explicitly defines instructions neither finalized nor rejected as queued on the clearing network pending reconciliation in the subsequent cycle
recommended_action: Do not execute a ledger rollback; hold SETTLE_BATCH_8102 in HELD/PENDING status, retain transaction escrow, and await final disposition in the subsequent clearing cycle bilateral statement or perform an out-of-band payment status inquiry.
